jobs.employer_name: Internationella Engelska Skolan i Sverige AB
jobs.description:
Vi söker just nu en kvalificerad fritidsledare till vårt fritidsteam. Som fritidsledare på IES Sigtuna kommer du att arbeta med att leverera omsorg och stöd före och efter skoltid till våra elever i F-6 och ansvara för att undervisa i enlighet med den nationella fritidsläroplanen. Förutom att utföra ovanstående uppgifter kommer du också att ansvara för att ge specialiserat stöd till eleverna baserat på deras individuella behov. Vi söker personal som, precis som vi, tror på att ge eleverna möjlighet att förverkliga sin fulla potential, oavsett bakgrund. Du måste också vara kunnig och passionerad när det gäller utbildning och barn. Du ska ha verktygen för att skapa en lugn miljö och kunna inspirera eleverna. 

Du ingår i en arbetsgrupp som tillsammans planerar och utvecklar fritidsverksamheten. Du förstår vikten av att samarbeta med dina kollegor, upprätthålla rutiner och regler, se möjligheter, ta stort eget ansvar samt ha ett vänligt och respektfullt bemötande mot alla du möter i arbetet. Vidare måste du ha en god förmåga att skapa positiva relationer med elever, vårdnadshavare och personal. Ytterligare egenskaper vi söker är att du kan arbeta strukturerat, men samtidigt vågar vara flexibel. Förmågan att leda i grupp för att motivera och skapa delaktighet är oerhört viktig. Du arbetar bra i team, men kan också ta egna initiativ.

Vi sätter barnet i centrum under hela skoldagen. Vi har en positiv inställning till elevers och kollegors förmågor och vi reflekterar ständigt över hur vi som vuxna tillsammans kan påverka den undervisning vi bedriver i en positiv riktning.

Den här personen bör vara behörig inom något av följande områden:

- Fritidspedagog
- Fritidsledare
- Fritidslärare
- Lärare mot fritidshemmet

IES Sigtuna är en internationell skolmiljö, därför är flytande kunskaper i både engelska och svenska meriterande.

Internationella Engelska Skolan Sigtuna är belägen i ett nybyggt grönområde i Sigtuna kommun och ståtar med den historiska och vackra staden Sigtuna. IES Sigtuna är en skola där varje elev blir sedd och hörd och där du får möjlighet att göra skillnad i deras liv.

Internationella Engelska Skolan är en verkligt internationell skola. Vi har personal och elever från hela världen som bidrar till en dynamisk internationell atmosfär. Våra skolor är tvåspråkiga med upp till 50% av undervisningen på engelska och följer den svenska nationella läroplanen.

Ansök nu och se till att ladda upp ditt CV och ditt personliga brev på vår IES Careers-webbplats.

Internationella Engelska Skolan (IES) is a leading independent school group with academic results far above average and a diverse and energetic staff. Teaching is in both Swedish and English, and the hallways are bilingual. The language of meetings and communication amongst the staff is English.

IES is one of Sweden's largest school groups at compulsory school level with 46 schools and around 30,000 students across the country. IES has grown steadily and maintained quality since 1993.

jobs.occupation: Teacher Librarian, Bladins International School of Malmö
jobs.description:
At Bladins International School of Malmö (BISM), we are looking for an enthusiastic Teacher Librarian to join our Primary Years Programme (PYP) and Middle Years Programme (MYP) in January 2027.
If you are passionate about inspiring a love of reading, developing information literacy and supporting learning in an international school, we would love to hear from you.
About Bladins International School of Malmö
BISM is an IB Continuum School in central Malmö, offering the Primary Years Programme (PYP) and Middle Years Programme (MYP) to approximately 360 students from diverse nationalities and cultures.
As part of Bladins Foundation, a non-profit educational organisation, we provide a supportive, internationally minded learning environment where students grow into knowledgeable, caring and responsible global citizens.
The Role
As Teacher Librarian, you will promote reading, inquiry-based learning and students' research, information literacy and critical thinking skills across PYP and MYP.
BISM has two dedicated libraries, one for PYP and one for MYP. You will develop these as welcoming and inclusive learning spaces and work closely with teachers to support learning across the curriculum.
Key responsibilities include:

Developing and managing both school libraries and their print and digital collections

Promoting reading for pleasure through library lessons, initiatives and events

Teaching information literacy, research skills, digital literacy and critical thinking

Collaborating with teachers to support PYP units of inquiry and MYP subjects, with awareness of the curriculum across MYP

Supporting students' Approaches to Learning (ATL) skills, including ethical use of information, referencing and academic integrity

Ensuring resources reflect the school's international, multilingual community and diverse learning needs

Building positive relationships with students, colleagues and families and engaging with the wider BISM community

Contributing to school development and a welcoming library environment

Who We Are Looking For
We are looking for a qualified, proactive Teacher Librarian with a passion for literacy and student learning.
You are:

Qualified in library and information science, preferably with school library experience

Experienced in supporting children's and young people's reading, research and information literacy

Knowledgeable about children's and young adult literature and able to inspire readers of different ages

Skilled in inquiry-based learning and collaboration with classroom and subject teachers

Confident using digital library systems, educational technology and online resources

Inclusive, organised and able to manage library activities independently

A positive communicator and collaborative member of an international team

Committed to professional development

Experience with the International Baccalaureate (IB), particularly PYP and/or MYP, is an advantage. Understanding the IB philosophy, Learner Profile and Approaches to Learning (ATL) is highly valued.
As English is the school's working language, professional spoken and written English is required.
Why Join BISM?
At BISM, you will join a welcoming international community committed to students, colleagues and learning. We offer supportive colleagues, professional development, an IB learning environment and the opportunity to make a meaningful difference to students' development.
Employment Information
Position: Teacher Librarian  Employment type: Permanent employment, with a six-month probationary period  Working hours: Part-time (60%)  Start date: January 2027
Application
Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis. Please apply by 30 November 2026.
For more information, contact:
Kumari Nevill, Primary School Principal Kumari.nevill@bladins.se
We look forward to welcoming a colleague who shares our commitment to high-quality education, collaboration and student success.

jobs.occupation: Associate Senior Lecturer in Applied Geophysics
jobs.description:
Do you want to develop your research and teaching in an environment where collaboration with industry and society is a natural part of the work? With us, you will collaborate with dedicated colleagues, have access to modern research infrastructure, and enjoy strong opportunities to attract external funding. You will have the space to make a real difference for your students, your research, and society at large.
The Applied Geophysics research group is part of the Division of Geoscience and Environmental Technology at the Department of Civil Engineering and Natural Resources in Luleå University of Technology. The department consists of approximately 400 employees, and research is conducted in the fields of geoscience, geoengineering, mining, metallurgy and civil engineering technology. The department has well-developed collaborations with research institutes, industrial partners and governmental agencies. The environment at the department is open, dynamic and brings together researchers as well as students from all over the world. It is one of the world’s longest standing research groups continuously active in mineral exploration and geoelectromagnetic studies.
 
 
Subject description
 
Applied Geophysics includes studies of how the laws and methods of physics can be used to understand the properties of bedrock and soil deposits. This includes development and applications of methods for exploration and investigation of natural resources such as mineral deposits and water, as well as investigation of environmental and infrastructural related issues.
 
 
Duties
 
Applied geophysics covers a wide range of geophysical methods and the assistant senior lecturer is expected to have the ability, interest and willingness to contribute to teaching of relevant methods. Collaboration with teachers in other geoscience disciplines is an integral part of the duties. Research-based teaching is seen as important to maintain high quality and to be in line with new developments in applied geophysics. Therefore, the assistant senior lecturer is expected to participate actively in research projects.
 
 
These tasks means that you will:
Be responsible for developing, teaching and examining courses in applied geophysics, both at first and second cycle levels / at all study cycle levels. Supervise students and follow the subject's international development
Work with research tasks (e.g., applying for external research funding, leading and collaborating in research projects, data collection, communicating and disseminating research results via academic publications)
Network and collaborate with actors nationally and internationally
Be active in the applied geophysics research community.

Qualifications
 
To meet the requirements for the appointment as associate senior lecturer, the applicant:
must have been awarded a doctoral degree or must have a foreign degree considered equivalent to a doctoral degree. It must be within following areas:
Geophysics
Physics (with specialization in electromagnetism or computational physics) or a closely related numerically intensive discipline.

The candidate should have completed a doctoral degree no more than five years before the end of the application period. A candidate that completed the doctoral degree earlier may apply if there are special reasons such as leave due to illness, parental leave, clinical service of trust, or similar circumstances.
 
 
Assessment criteria
 
The following assessment criteria apply to this position:
scientific expertise
other assessment criteria.

Other assessment criteria is weighted equally:
ability to plan and perform geophysical fieldwork
the degree of expertise required for qualification
administrative proficiency that is of value in view of the subject matter and the duties included in the appointment
the ability to collaborate with the wider community
the ability to obtain external research and development funding
the ability to communicate research and development work
the ability to teach in Swedish and/or in English

Period of employment
 
This position is for an employment period of four years.
 
 
Promotion to senior lecturer
 
An assistant senior lecturer shall, upon application, be promoted to senior lecturer on a permanent position. That the applicant is qualified for a position as senior lecturer and is deemed suitable for such a position in an examination, is determined in accordance with the assessment criteria set out below:
 
 
In the examination, it is required that the associate senior lecturer has completed higher education pedagogical education corresponding to 7.5 credits or has acquired corresponding knowledge in another way.
 
 
During the employment period, the associate senior lecturer must also independently, to a considerable extent and with high quality, contribute to the university's research and demonstrate good pedagogical skills.
 
 
Information
 
You are employed by the university and the position includes salary and full social insurance. It is a full-time fixed term employment for four years with placement in Luleå.
 
 
For further information about the position, please contact Professor Maxwell Meju, +46 920-492261, mailto:maxwell.mej@ltu.se
 
 
For each position, a preliminary https://www.ltu.se/en/about-the-university/work-with-us/applying-for-a-job#h-Informationonpaytransparency is provided based on the requirements, responsibilities, and market conditions associated with the role.https://www.ltu.se/en/about-the-university/work-with-us/applying-for-a-job#h-Tradeunioncontacts

The High-Power Laboratory is one of the few laboratories in the world that are unique in verifying the function of high-voltage products under various switching moments that can occur in the power grid. Carrying out type tests according to international standards and development tests for our customers, who come from all over the world.

Responsibility for electrical safety and the plant under test.
Analyzing the test results and writing technical reports, mainly in English.

jobs.description:
Fujitsu Sweden AB är en ledande leverantör av IT-tjänster, digital transformation och affärskritiska tekniklösningar. Som en del av den globala Fujitsu-koncernen hjälper vi företag, myndigheter och organisationer att utveckla sin verksamhet genom innovativa lösningar inom molntjänster, infrastruktur, data, AI och IT-drift. 
Med cirka 600 medarbetare i Sverige kombinerar vi lokal närvaro med global expertis för att skapa hållbara och framtidssäkra lösningar. Våra kunder finns inom såväl offentlig sektor som industri, handel, bank och finans, där vi bidrar till ökad effektivitet, högre säkerhet och bättre användarupplevelser genom teknik och innovation.
QA Lead (Consulting Assignment) - Fujitsu Sweden
Do you want to lead quality assurance in a complex IT environment and play a key role in delivering successful outcomes for both customers and the business? Fujitsu Sweden is currently seeking an experienced QA Lead for a long-term consulting assignment covering a parental leave period.
In this role, you will be responsible for the overall QA strategy, lead testing and quality assurance activities, and ensure that deliveries meet agreed quality, timeline, and budget requirements. You will serve as a central point of contact between customers, stakeholders, suppliers, and internal teams.
About the Assignment
Role: QA Lead
Workload: 100%
Location: Stockholm (Marievik/Liljeholmen and Sveavägen)
Remote Work: Partially possible
Start Date: Week 50 of December 2026, alternatively January 11, 2027
End Date: September 15, 2027
Language: Swedish or English, both spoken and written

Key Responsibilities
As a QA Lead, you will:
Own and drive the overall QA and test strategy.
Define test scope, methodology, priorities, and test plans together with business stakeholders and customers.
Lead and coordinate the QA team, including resource planning and allocation.
Ensure testing activities are delivered according to budget, schedule, and quality requirements.
Manage test environments, test data, tools, and other dependencies.
Track, report, and communicate status, risks, deviations, and quality outcomes to stakeholders.
Participate in customer meetings and act as a trusted quality assurance advisor.
Provide estimates for new assignments and change requests.
Drive continuous improvements in testing processes, automation, defect management, and quality assurance practices.
Ensure the delivery of KPIs and quality reports.

We Are Looking for Someone Who
Has several years of experience leading QA and testing organizations.
Has documented experience in test management, quality governance, and delivery responsibility.
Is accustomed to working closely with customers and a variety of stakeholders.
Has strong capabilities in resource planning, risk management, and driving quality initiatives.
Is communicative, structured, and confident in a leadership role.
Has experience preparing estimates, reports, and decision-making material.
Is fluent in Swedish or English, both written and spoken.

Preferred Qualifications
Experience with Point of Sale (POS) solutions and retail systems.
Experience with test automation and QA process improvement initiatives.
Previous experience working in large outsourcing or service delivery organizations.

Key Deliverables
Overall QA strategy
Test plans and test execution activities
Resource and capacity planning
QA estimates for new assignments and change requests
Status and risk reports
Recommendations for test sign-off and closure
Quality assurance improvement plans

Does this sound like the right assignment for you? Send us your updated CV as soon as possible. Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis.
About Barona
Barona is one of the leading companies in the Nordic region within recruitment, staffing, outsourcing, and workforce solutions. Since its founding in Helsinki in 1999, Barona has expanded to ten countries and helps more than 30,000 people each year advance in their careers.
In Sweden, Barona operates from several locations, including Stockholm, Gothenburg, Malmö, Falun, and Strömsund, delivering talent and workforce solutions nationwide. With us, both customers and employees have the opportunity to grow in an innovative and forward-thinking organization.
